_readme: Supplier page details for Senior Lifestyle Business, gathered 17 Nov 2026 from each company's own website (title, meta description, header logo). dark:true means the logo is white and is shown on a dark tile. An empty website or logo means we could not confirm one: leave it empty rather than guess. Sector drives the filter on the hub.

Conran and Partners.line: Architecture and interior design studio, now part of DLR Group.

DLR Group.line: Integrated design firm working in architecture, engineering, interiors and planning.

Healthsperien.line: Health consultancy working with NIC on a resident health outcomes study.

Jim's Gym.line: Online fitness and wellbeing classes for adults aged over 55.

LifeLoop.line: Engagement and wellness software for senior living communities.

Percussion Play.line: Makes outdoor musical instruments for parks, schools, care settings and public spaces.

Silverchain.line: Australian provider of health care and aged care at home.

SLIB.line: Senior Living Investment Brokerage, a US real estate brokerage selling senior housing and care assets.

Tarkett.line: Commercial and residential flooring maker, including vinyl, linoleum, wood and luxury vinyl tiles.

Tunstall Healthcare.line: Technology-enabled care and telecare for health, housing and care providers.

Walker & Dunlop.line: US commercial real estate finance and advisory firm covering financing, sales, valuation and loan servicing.
